messages:
Alex: Who's up for a quick lunchtime Power Circuit + Dyno Challenge today? 12:15–12:45 in the garage space. 3 stations: rower 5min, KB swings 3x12, dyno wall fun (scaled). Bring sneakers and hype. :muscle:
Jamie: heck yes. I can bring a 12kg and a mini pad. :raising_hand:
Priya: would love to but back-to-back meetings today, sad emoji. :disappointed:
Sam: I’m remote but will cheer from Slack and keep score in the spreadsheet — link: https://tiny.redwood/fitness-scores 
Taylor: sign me up. beginner options ok? never done a dyno. :grimacing:
Alex: totally — scaled options: lighter KB, step-ups or a static reach instead of a full dyno. safety first.
Rob: I’ll be there. Can we make a quick 2-team relay so people can rotate? keeps it chill and social. :clap:
Emily: I’ll bring a small crash pad and a spotter. Also will time the row intervals.
Nora: what about post-workout smoothies? I can swing by the cafe and grab 6. green or berry?
Alex: Berry sounds great. I’ll cover the tab. :moneybag:
Taylor: putting myself down for team A. small ask — any warmup suggestions?
Alex: 5 min dynamic warmup: jump rope or jog in place, shoulder circles, 2x mini hang for fingers.
Sam: added column "attendance" to the spreadsheet and pinged @here for anyone else who wants in.
fitbot: Reminder: "Gym area usage" policy — please sign out equipment when done and wipe chalk off pads.
Rob: Also can we do a low-key leaderboard to keep people motivated? weekly points for attempts + form.
Jamie: love that. 1st attempt dyno gets bonus points. :trophy:
Emily: leaving desk in 5, see you all there.
Priya: cheering you on! take pics for those of us missing it. :camera_with_flash:
